NineSwordTechniques:UnsheathedBladePower.NAME: Unsheathed Blade
DESCRIPTIONS: Each stack doubles the damage dealt by Attack cards.

NineSwordTechniques:GhostlySwordPower.NAME: Ghostly Sword
DESCRIPTIONS: Ghostly Sword technique cards deal %d additional damage this combat.

NineSwordTechniques:VoidBladeStylePower.NAME: Void Blade Style
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each turn, gain %d Strength, Dexterity, Focus, and Metallicize.

NineSwordTechniques:Vitality.NAME: Vitality
DESCRIPTIONS: You have %d Vitality. Gaining it increases temporary Max HP; it is spent by several cards and clears after combat.

NineSwordTechniques:Wither.NAME: Wither
DESCRIPTIONS: You have %d Wither. Each stack reduces temporary Max HP by 1. Gaining Vitality removes Wither first, but the Max HP change remains until combat ends.

NineSwordTechniques:VitalityMaxHealth.NAME: Temporary Max HP
DESCRIPTIONS: Temporary Max HP change this combat: %d. Restored after combat.

NineSwordTechniques:Paralysis.NAME: Paralysis
DESCRIPTIONS: Lose %d Strength and Dexterity this turn. Restored and removed at the end of the target's turn.

NineSwordTechniques:MuzixiPersona.NAME: Muzixi
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, gain 3 Block and 1 Vitality.

NineSwordTechniques:TearPersona.NAME: Leixier
DESCRIPTIONS: When entering this persona, spend up to 9 Harmonic Soul. Draw 1 card and gain 1 Energy per stack.

NineSwordTechniques:Evergreen.NAME: Evergreen
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you gain Vitality, gain %d Block for each point gained.

NineSwordTechniques:NaturalCycle.NAME: Natural Cycle
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, spend up to %d Vitality. For each spent, draw 1 card and gain 1 Energy.

NineSwordTechniques:AncientBark.NAME: Ancient Bark
DESCRIPTIONS: At the end of your turn, if you have at least 6 Vitality, gain %d Block.

NineSwordTechniques:HarmonicSoul.NAME: Harmonic Soul
DESCRIPTIONS: When entering Leixier, spend up to 9. Draw 1 card and gain 1 Energy per stack spent.

NineSwordTechniques:WorldTree.NAME: World Tree
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever Energy decreases by 1, gain 1 Vitality %d time(s).

NineSwordTechniques:VitalityTide.NAME: Vitality Tide
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your next turn, gain %d Vitality.

NineSwordTechniques:VitalityReservoir.NAME: Vitality Reservoir
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each turn, gain %d Vitality.

NineSwordTechniques:ThickenedLifeblood.NAME: Thickened Lifeblood
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you gain Vitality, heal %d HP for each point gained.

NineSwordTechniques:LivingArmor.NAME: Living Armor
DESCRIPTIONS: At the end of your turn, if you have at least %d Vitality, gain %d Block.

NineSwordTechniques:ParalyticField.NAME: Paralytic Field
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each turn, apply %d Paralysis to ALL enemies.

NineSwordTechniques:NumbingEcho.NAME: Numbing Echo
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time during each of your turns that you apply Paralysis to a valid target, apply the same amount %d additional time(s).

NineSwordTechniques:NerveLock.NAME: Nerve Lock
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of the target's turn, apply %d Paralysis to it.

NineSwordTechniques:AbsoluteParalysis.NAME: Absolute Paralysis
DESCRIPTIONS: Enemy Paralysis loses only half its stacks (rounded up) at the end of their turn.

NineSwordTechniques:DualityConvergence.NAME: Duality Convergence
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever you change persona, gain %d Vitality and apply %d Paralysis to ALL enemies.
